doc: -- | The PSX backend that hosts a message-passing view inside Screamer: a
-- | `Markup Msg` view, with handlers that send messages, becomes a Screamer
-- | `Element` through `sink`. Lowered `.psx` code calls it through the alias
-- | The core is hand-written in `Screamer.Psx.Sink.Core`. Attributes take a
-- | constant or a `Signal` of their type, as in `Screamer.Psx`; `oninput` is
-- | given the target's value and the keyboard events their event.
imports: Screamer.Psx.Sink.Core (constant, element, handler, keyHandler, svgElement, valueHandler) as Impl

element.type: forall c a. Content c a => Array (Attr a) -> c -> Node a

svgElement.type: forall c a. Content c a => Array (Attr a) -> c -> Node a

boolean.type: forall v a. S.AttrValue v Boolean => v -> Attr a

string.type: forall v a. S.AttrValue v String => v -> Attr a

number.type: forall v a. S.AttrValue v Int => v -> Attr a

imports: Screamer.Psx.Sink (class Children, class Content, class ToKey)
core: forall c a. Content c a => String -> Array (B.Attr a) -> c -> B.Node a
forall k a. ToKey k => k -> B.Node a -> Tuple B.Key (B.Node a)
forall a. String -> String -> B.Attr a
forall c r. Children c r => c -> r
forall a. B.Markup a -> B.Node a
extra: -- | What a child hole takes: a string, a node, markup, a Screamer element,
-- | a signal of a string or of markup, and arrays and `Maybe`s of those.
childHoles :: forall a. B.Node a -> Element -> B.Markup a
-- | What a child hole takes to make keyed children: keyed literals and
-- | arrays of them, keyed by strings or by integers.
keyedChildHoles :: forall a. B.Node a -> Array (Tuple B.Key (B.Node a))
-- | An element takes keyed children as it takes plain ones.
keyedContent :: forall a. B.Node a -> Array (B.Node a)
-- | A view becomes a Screamer element given its sink.
sink :: forall a. (a -> Effect Unit) -> B.Node a -> Element
-- | Attributes take a signal of their type as well as a constant.
[ B.div [ B.class_ (pure "on" :: Signal String), B.hidden (pure true :: Signal Boolean), B.tabindex (pure 0 :: Signal Int) ] B.none
, B.input [ B.value (pure "" :: Signal String), B.checked (pure false :: Signal Boolean) ] B.none
